answer: Sustained-attention challenge escrow requires each identity to answer a context-bound microtask in a short window seeded by a shared beacon. Missing two windows in a rolling day suspends it; local witnesses, including sparse tundra relays, prevent one host from batch-answering many identities. An attacker pays real operator attention and scheduling slack per identity, and as the horizon shrinks, keeping N sybils responsive costs N times that budget.
